figurative_meaning_en: A person who fulfills all desires
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই বন্ধু সত্যিই বাঞ্ছাকল্পতরুর মতো সাহায্য করে।
example_sentences_in_english: His wife is the Kalpataru of his life.
This friend truly acts like a wish-fulfilling tree in helping out.
history: Derived from Hindu mythology, where Kalpataru is a divine tree that grants wishes, originating from stories like the churning of the ocean (Samudra Manthan) in Puranas.
note: The idiom draws from Sanskrit roots and is prevalent in Bengali literature influenced by Vaishnava and Shaiva traditions.
